en.answer: In the proposed scenario, since the effect of <<11996>> has been activated and resolved normally, even if <<5914>> is activated so that <<11996>> leaves the field, the part of the effect that adds a monster to the hand resolves normally.
en.question: After the chain in which the effect of <<11996>> that adds a monster to the hand during the End Phase was activated, if <<5914>> is activated, so that <<11996>> has left the field before the End Phase, what happens with the effect of <<11996>>?
en.title: After the chain in which the effect of <<11996>> that adds a monster to the hand during the End Phase was activated, if <<5914>> is activated, so that <<11996>> has left the field before the End Phase, what happens with the effect of <<11996>>?

ja.answer: 質問の状況の場合、「<<11996>>」のモンスター効果の発動の際のチェーンブロックの処理が通常通り行われていますので、その後に「<<5914>>」が発動し、「<<11996>>」がフィールドを離れている場合でも、エンドフェイズに『デッキからPモンスター１体を手札に加える』処理は通常通り適用する事になります。
